info.title: AI Gateway API
info.description: A unified API gateway for multiple AI providers. OpenAI-compatible ops are served under /{app_id}/v1/*; other paths under /{app_id} are rejected.

post.summary: Demo: resolve caller (via real Zuplo API key + Consumer metadata) to an enterprise Vertex AI account and perform a real Google OAuth2 token exchange
post.description: Authenticates the caller with Zuplo's real API Key Authentication policy. The enterprise account to use is read from the authenticated Consumer's metadata (request.user.data.enterpriseAccount) - a genuine Zuplo-managed identity record, not a hardcoded lookup table - then a real Google service-account JWT is signed and exchanged with Google's live oauth2.googleapis.com/token endpoint.

404.description: Authenticated consumer has no enterpriseAccount metadata mapped

get.summary: OIDC discovery document for JWT auth issuer
get.description: Minimal OpenID discovery document so OpenIdJwtInboundPolicy can resolve this issuer, matching how real IdPs (Auth0, Zuplo's own auth service) expose discovery metadata.
Publishes the public key used to verify JWTs the baseball Worker signs for the baseball-jwt-auth-inbound policy.

get,post,delete.description: Routes AI requests under /{app_id}/* to the AI Gateway handler. The configuration loader loads the application configuration from the app_id path segment; the configuration executor then runs the application's inboundPolicyChain. Only paths whose suffix is a supported /v1/... operation succeed (/v1/chat/completions, /v1/embeddings, /v1/messages, /v1/responses and its sub-resources); anything else under /{app_id} returns 404.

401.description: Unauthorized — returned only when the application's inboundPolicyChain includes ai-gateway-auth-v2-inbound, or authentication runs before the configuration loader

403.description: Forbidden — returned by per-app policies, such as an API key issued for a different app_id or a model the app does not allow
